section_desc: Undergraduate curriculum structures, credit requirements, tuition fees, and admission criteria at the Faculty of Arts, Chula.
tuition_regular_desc: Taught primarily in Thai. Students choose their specific major in the second year.
tuition_international_desc: Bachelor of Arts in Language and Culture. Taught entirely in English, focusing on global affairs and culture.
admission_desc: Details regarding undergraduate admission criteria at the Faculty of Arts, Chulalongkorn University.
structure_faculty_core_desc: Foundational courses required for all Arts students to develop deep understanding of humanities (e.g. Literary Criticism, Western/Eastern Civilizations).
structure_major_courses_desc: Specialized courses in your chosen major to build expert knowledge and professional competencies.
structure_gen_ed_desc: Interdisciplinary courses from outside the faculty that promote life-long learning, scientific reasoning, and social awareness.

admission.tcas_round1_desc: Based on academic achievements, language proficiency certifications, and social/community activities.
admission.tcas_round2_desc: For outstanding students from regional areas or language collaboration programs.
admission.tcas_round3_desc: Evaluated using TGAT and A-Level exam scores based on the specific weighting of the faculty.
admission.tgas_req: TGAT and/or A-Level scores as specified by the faculty

thai.title: Thai Language Major
thai.description: Deep dive into Thai language structures, literature, and culture. Focuses on critical literary analysis, linguistics, and creative communications.
thai.requirements: High school diploma or equivalent. Passionate about Thai language, classical and modern literature, and creative content creation.

english.title: English Major
english.description: Develops advanced English communication skills, critical analysis of Western literature, linguistics, and cultural studies. Tailored for global careers.
english.requirements: High school diploma or equivalent. Meets minimum English proficiency test score requirements as declared by the university.

history.title: History Major
history.description: Systematic study of Thai and world history. Learn how to critically analyze, interpret, and evaluate historical records and primary source materials.
history.requirements: High school diploma or equivalent. Passionate about historical research, archives, and possesses strong critical thinking skills.

geography.title: Geography & Geoinformatics Major
geography.description: Examines human-environment interactions through spatial analysis. Gain hands-on experience in GIS (Geographic Information Systems) and remote sensing.
geography.requirements: High school diploma or equivalent. Interested in maps, environmental studies, resource management, and computer geoinformatics.

philosophy.title: Philosophy Major
philosophy.description: Study Eastern and Western philosophical traditions. Focuses on critical thinking, ethical analysis, logic, and debates on contemporary global issues.
philosophy.requirements: High school diploma or equivalent. Enjoys reading, logical reasoning, and open-minded discussions on diverse points of view.

information.title: Information Studies Major
information.description: Study library sciences, information architecture, metadata curation, and data analytics to drive knowledge management in the digital age.
information.requirements: High school diploma or equivalent. Passionate about digital technologies, data curation, and organizational analytics.

french.title: French Major
french.description: Mastery of the French language, Francophone literature, and cultural history to foster careers in diplomacy, translation, and international trade.
french.requirements: High school diploma or equivalent. French language proficiency background as specified in university guidelines.

german.title: German Major
german.description: Deep study of German language systems, European history, and advanced communication skills tailored for global business and translation sectors.
german.requirements: High school diploma or equivalent. Strong interest in European languages, cultures, and global commerce.

japanese.title: Japanese Major
japanese.description: Advanced Japanese linguistics, modern literature, and historical studies designed for international corporate operations and cultural exchanges.
japanese.requirements: High school diploma or equivalent. Meets minimum Japanese language requirements or standardized test criteria.

chinese.title: Chinese Major
chinese.description: Acquire professional fluency in Chinese. Studies classical and modern literature, history, and economic relations in the East Asian region.
chinese.requirements: High school diploma or equivalent. Meets specified Chinese language test criteria as declared.

pali.title: Pali and Sanskrit Major
pali.description: Exploration of ancient Indo-Aryan languages, Buddhist scriptures, and comparative linguistics to research historical philosophies and heritage.
pali.requirements: High school diploma or equivalent. Passionate about classical linguistic structures, texts, and archeology.

spanish.title: Spanish Major
spanish.description: Fluency in Spanish alongside literature and social histories of Spain and Latin America. Prepares graduates for international development roles.
spanish.requirements: High school diploma or equivalent. Enthusiastic about global foreign languages and multilingual relations.

italian.title: Italian Major
italian.description: Mastery of Italian communication, art history, fashion industries, food cultures, and literature to build careers in creative industries.
italian.requirements: High school diploma or equivalent. Passionate about art history, European heritage, and creative design industries.

korean.title: Korean Major
korean.description: Focuses on Korean linguistics, modern media industries, pop cultures, and history. Prepares graduates for roles in international media and relations.
korean.requirements: High school diploma or equivalent. Standardized Korean proficiency test results as required.

arabic.title: Arabic Major
arabic.description: Mastery of Arabic language alongside cultural histories of the Middle East, preparing graduates for aviation, embassy, and corporate roles.
arabic.requirements: High school diploma or equivalent. Interested in Middle Eastern languages, history, and international relations.

south_asian.title: South Asian Languages Major
south_asian.description: Study of Hindi, regional histories, and Indian socio-political systems to enable trade, diplomacy, and cultural exchanges.
south_asian.requirements: High school diploma or equivalent. Passionate about commercial trade and relations in the South Asian region.

balac.title: Language and Culture (BALAC)
balac.description: International program focusing on cultural studies, critical media analysis, and comparative languages, tailored for global creative leadership.
balac.requirements: High school diploma or equivalent. Standardized English proficiency test scores (TOEFL, IELTS, CU-TEP) meeting faculty requirements.
